Option helpers for as_widget()

Source: R/options.R
widget-options.Rd

These helpers group related as_widget() settings into one argument each:

Usage

tooltip_options(delay = 0, follow = TRUE, sticky = FALSE, style = NULL)

export_options(filename = "plot", scale = 1)

navigator_options(height = 56)

render_options(
  mode = c("auto", "svg", "raster"),
  raster_threshold = 20000L,
  text = c("native", "outline")
)

Arguments

delay

Milliseconds to wait before the tooltip appears on hover (default 0, i.e. immediate). The highlight is unaffected — only the tooltip waits. A short delay (e.g. 250) calms a dense scatter.

follow

When TRUE (default) the tooltip tracks the cursor; when FALSE it anchors above the hovered mark's centre.

sticky

When TRUE, the tooltip accepts pointer events and lingers briefly when you leave the mark, so you can move into it — for tooltips that contain links or buttons (build the HTML via tooltip = in the plot). Default FALSE.

style

Optional named list styling the tooltip box: background / color (any R or CSS colour), fontsize, and max_width (any CSS length; a bare number is used as is). NULL (default) uses the built-in style. Tooltip text is rendered as safe HTML — an author-built tooltip = (e.g. via glue()) may use <b>/<i>/<br> for bold/italic/line breaks; data values are escaped and only those inert tags are honoured (no scripts/attributes).

filename

The download filename base, without extension (default "plot").

scale

The PNG resolution multiplier (default 1). Exports capture the current (zoomed/panned) view.

height

Height of the navigator strip in pixels (default 56). Passing navigator_options() to as_widget(navigator = ) turns the navigator on; navigator = TRUE is the same as navigator = navigator_options().

mode

Rendering strategy for the marks. "auto" (default) ships a per-element SVG for small/moderate plots and switches to a single embedded raster image above raster_threshold keyed elements; "svg" always uses the per-element SVG; "raster" always uses the image. In raster mode the marks are drawn once as a base image and all interaction (hover, click, brush, pan/zoom) is driven client-side from the element index (geometry + boxes + keys), so a very large scatter (100k+ points) stays navigable with a tiny DOM and a small payload. The trade-offs of raster mode: per-element grammar colours, per-mark screen-reader focus, and display-tier cross-filtering do not apply (there are no per-element DOM nodes), and a zoomed-in view is a scaled raster until re-rendered.

raster_threshold

Keyed-element count above which mode = "auto" switches to the raster image (default 20000).

text

How text is written into the SVG, passed to vellum::scene_svg(): "native" (default) emits selectable <text> referencing system fonts — smaller when the page has the font, post-processable, and better for accessibility and LLMs; "outline" emits glyph outlines that are pixel-faithful and font-independent but not selectable. Applies to the per-element SVG path only; in raster mode text is baked into the base image and this argument is ignored (with a warning if set explicitly).

Value

An object of class vellumwidget_tooltip_options, vellumwidget_export_options, vellumwidget_navigator_options or vellumwidget_render_options, to pass to the matching as_widget() argument.

Details

  • tooltip_options() for the hover tooltip (as_widget(tooltip = ));

  • export_options() for the toolbar's SVG/PNG download (as_widget(export = ));

  • navigator_options() for the overview range navigator (as_widget(navigator = ));

  • render_options() for how the marks are drawn (as_widget(render = )).

Each validates its arguments and returns an object that as_widget() reads. Calling a helper with no arguments gives the defaults.

Examples

tooltip_options(delay = 250, style = list(background = "#1d3557"))
#> <tooltip_options>
#>   delay: 250
#>   follow: TRUE
#>   sticky: FALSE
#>   style: list(background = #1d3557)
export_options(filename = "mtcars", scale = 2)
#> <export_options>
#>   filename: mtcars
#>   scale: 2
navigator_options(height = 80)
#> <navigator_options>
#>   height: 80
render_options(mode = "raster")
#> <render_options>
#>   mode: raster
#>   raster_threshold: 20000
#>   text: native

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(vellumplot)
vplot(mtcars) |>
  mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, tooltip = rownames(mtcars)) |>
  as_widget(
    tooltip = tooltip_options(delay = 250, follow = FALSE),
    export = export_options(filename = "mtcars", scale = 2)
  )
} # }
